diff --git a/lib/tablefmt.rb b/lib/tablefmt.rb
index eed59a0..473220d 100644
--- a/lib/tablefmt.rb
+++ b/lib/tablefmt.rb
@@ -1,9 +1,13 @@
 # Plain-text tables.
 class TableFmt
+  ELLIPSIS = "…"
+  ALIGNMENTS = %i[left right].freeze
+
   attr_reader :headers, :rows
 
   def initialize(headers)
     @headers = headers.map(&:to_s)
+    @alignments = Array.new(@headers.size, :left)
     @rows = []
   end
 
@@ -13,4 +17,85 @@ class TableFmt
     @rows << row.map(&:to_s)
     self
   end
+
+  # Width of each column: the longest of the header and all its cells.
+  def widths
+    @headers.each_index.map do |i|
+      [@headers[i].length, *@rows.map { |r| r[i].length }].max
+    end
+  end
+
+  # Set per-column alignment. Keys are header names, values :left or :right.
+  def align(spec)
+    spec.each do |name, value|
+      i = @headers.index(name.to_s)
+      raise KeyError, "unknown column #{name.inspect}" if i.nil?
+      raise ArgumentError, "unknown alignment #{value.inspect}" unless ALIGNMENTS.include?(value)
+
+      @alignments[i] = value
+    end
+    self
+  end
+
+  # Render as a plain-text table. Cells longer than +max_width+ are
+  # truncated with an ellipsis.
+  def to_s(max_width: nil)
+    ws = widths.map { |w| max_width ? [w, max_width].min : w }
+    lines = [text_row(@headers, ws, max_width: max_width)]
+    lines << ws.map { |w| "-" * w }.join(" ")
+    @rows.each { |row| lines << text_row(row, ws, max_width: max_width) }
+    lines.join("\n")
+  end
+
+  # Render as a GitHub-flavoured Markdown table.
+  def to_markdown
+    ws = widths
+    lines = [md_row(@headers, ws)]
+    lines << "|#{ws.each_index.map { |i| md_sep(ws[i], @alignments[i]) }.join("|")}|"
+    @rows.each { |row| lines << md_row(row, ws) }
+    lines.join("\n")
+  end
+
+  # Sort rows in place by the named column (optionally via a block that maps
+  # a cell to its sort key). Stable and chainable.
+  def sort_by!(column, &block)
+    i = @headers.index(column.to_s)
+    raise KeyError, "unknown column #{column.inspect}" if i.nil?
+
+    @rows.sort_by! { |row| block ? block.call(row[i]) : row[i] }
+    self
+  end
+
+  private
+
+  def text_row(cells, ws, max_width: nil)
+    cells.each_index.map do |i|
+      c = max_width ? truncate(cells[i], max_width) : cells[i]
+      pad(c, ws[i], @alignments[i])
+    end.join(" ").rstrip
+  end
+
+  def md_row(cells, ws)
+    cells.each_index.map do |i|
+      " " + pad(escape_md(cells[i]), ws[i], @alignments[i]) + " "
+    end.then { |parts| "|#{parts.join("|")}|" }
+  end
+
+  def md_sep(width, alignment)
+    alignment == :right ? ("-" * (width + 1) + ":") : (":" + "-" * (width + 1))
+  end
+
+  def pad(cell, width, alignment)
+    alignment == :right ? cell.rjust(width) : cell.ljust(width)
+  end
+
+  def truncate(cell, max_width)
+    return cell if cell.length <= max_width
+
+    cell[0...max_width - 1] + ELLIPSIS
+  end
+
+  def escape_md(cell)
+    cell.gsub("|", "\\|")
+  end
 end
result.summary:
Implemented the missing TableFmt behaviour in lib/tablefmt.rb (only file changed; test/ untouched):

- `widths`: per-column max of header + cell string lengths.
- `align(spec)`: sets per-column :left/:right; raises KeyError for unknown column names, ArgumentError for invalid alignment values; returns self.
- `to_s(max_width: nil)`: left/right-padded columns joined by a single space, rstripped; a dash separator row; cells longer than max_width truncated to (max_width-1) chars + "…", and column widths capped at max_width.
- `to_markdown`: `| cell |` rows with a `:---`/`---:` separator (width+1 dashes) and `|` escaped as `\|` in cell content.
- `sort_by!(column, &block)`: stable in-place sort by the named column (block maps cell→key, else the string value); returns self.
